WITH input AS (
    SELECT
        $1::text AS account_id,
        NULLIF($2::text, '__ALL_PRODUCTS__') AS product_id
)

SELECT
    a.account_id,
    o.order_id,
    o.order_date,
    o.order_status,
    ol.order_line_id,
    ol.product_id,
    p.sku,
    p.product_name,
    ol.quantity,
    ol.unit_price_idr,
    ol.installation_location

FROM accounts a
CROSS JOIN input i

LEFT JOIN orders o
    ON o.account_id = a.account_id
    AND o.order_status = 'COMPLETED'
    AND (
        i.product_id IS NULL
        OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM order_lines filtered
            WHERE filtered.order_id = o.order_id
              AND filtered.product_id = i.product_id
        )
    )

LEFT JOIN order_lines ol
    ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    AND (
        i.product_id IS NULL
        OR ol.product_id = i.product_id
    )

LEFT JOIN products p
    ON p.product_id = ol.product_id

WHERE a.account_id = i.account_id

ORDER BY
    o.order_date DESC NULLS LAST,
    o.order_id ASC,
    ol.order_line_id ASC;
